visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair and a white scoop-neck top stands in a brightly lit indoor space. She gestures with a V-sign and then holds a white jar with a green lid toward the lens. The background features white shelves with various crystals and stones under warm lighting. (2) A sharp transition to a close-up shot of the white jar, clearly showing the Cetaphil brand label and product name. The lighting is flat and bright. (3) A sequence showing two sets of products on a white surface with pink marble accents. Graphic text differentiates old and new packaging. (4) The woman returns to the frame, holding a large pump bottle of lotion and the green cream jar. She talks directly to the camera with high facial expressions, pointing at the cream jar while explaining features. (5) Montage: The woman is shown with a green headband, applying a thick layer of white cream to her bare face in a bathroom-like setting with white tile. She rubs her cheeks and neck vigorously. (6) Close-ups of the woman's face showing skin texture; she smiles and gives a thumbs-up. The skin looks hydrated and reflective. (7) She demonstrates textures by placing two white streaks of product on the back of her hand. One is labeled as lotion and the other as cream. (8) She points to a red spot on her neck and applies the white cream to it. The camera remains eye-level. (9) Finally, she holds three different Cetaphil products, including a new bottle with a green pump, smiling and summarizing her points.

It aims to persuade viewers of the product's efficacy for sensitive and dry skin by combining scientific ingredient breakdowns with personal anecdotes from travel and practical demonstrations of different product textures.
